settings.label: model
settings.help: The model pi solves with, as the provider lists it. Required: pi.py refuses to run without one rather than fall back to pi's default. The suggestions are the openrouter lineup this dojo's own fighters run.

settings.label: thinking
settings.help: How hard pi thinks. Higher is slower and dearer, and the commit window does not wait.

settings.label: tools
settings.help: Empty: a pure model call. bash: pi may run shell commands to compute an answer, which is slower but wins the arithmetic belts it would otherwise get wrong.

settings.label: pi timeout (s)
settings.help: Seconds one pi call may take. Keep it under the bot's --solver-timeout or the bot gives up first.

settings.label: model slots
settings.help: How many pi processes may run at once on this machine, across every fighter that uses pi.

settings.label: slot wait (s)
settings.help: Seconds to wait for a free slot before giving up on the riddle.
